transcript: Here are three unbelievable humans whose lives feel almost impossible to explain. Number one, the woman who doesn't eat or drink. In Ethiopia, I met Mulu Work, a woman who claims she hasn't eaten or drunk anything for 16 years. Doctors reportedly found no traces of food in her body, yet she appears healthy and energetic. Did you breastfeed your child? Yes, my mother. There was no breast as much. No breast milk. She did not breastfeed. Number two, the mother of 44 children. In Uganda, a single mother known as Mama Uganda gave birth to 44 children before turning 40. She has a rare fertility condition and had 16 deliveries, including six sets of twins, four sets of triplets, and three sets of quadruplets. Despite the challenges, she strongly believes every child deserves love, care, and a chance to grow. Number three, the man who doesn't sleep. I flew to Vietnam to meet Mr. Ngoc, who claims he hasn't slept since 1962 after experiencing trauma during the Vietnam War. He works day and night making rice wine and doing daily labor. I spent a night with him and he really doesn't sleep. It remains a mystery how his body continues to function.
